[[File:Seatrooper.jpg|thumb|A seatrooper primary used blaster spearguns, modified from the E-11 rifle]]
A '''blaster speargun''' was a type of weapon. It was a modified [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster]] rifle that was also a [[Spear gun|speargun]] and it was used by [[Aquatic assault stormtrooper|sea troopers]].
